name: notif-quest-retires-on-claim
description: The featured wnotify quest (TURN ON NOTIFICATIONS) must disappear from the DAILY featured strip once its reward is claimed, while remaining on the WEEKLY tab as a normal claimed row. Drives the claim through the admin.completeMission tRPC endpoint (which force-completes AND auto-claims) because push opt-in cannot run under the vite dev server - notifications.optIn returns 500 'Devvit config is not available'. Requires the current emulator user to be an admin (u/bob - note usernames are stored WITH the 'u/' prefix; passing 'bob' returns 404 User not found). SIDE EFFECT: permanently marks wnotify claimed for bob for the current weekly period (~21d TTL). Never clicks .bnav-play - on the already-active PLAY tab that launches a casual match and leaves the lobby.

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.lb2-ft-news-row')].map(r => r.querySelector('.lb2-ft-news-title')?.textContent.trim()); return JSON.stringify({ tab: 'daily', rows }); })()
steps.name: A - daily rows BEFORE claim

steps.expression: (() => { window.__claimRes='PENDING'; fetch('/api/trpc/admin.completeMission',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({json:{username:'u/bob',type:'weekly',missionId:'wnotify'}})}).then(async r => { window.__claimRes = 'HTTP '+r.status+' '+(await r.text()).slice(0,400); }).catch(e => { window.__claimRes = 'THREW '+e.message; }); return 'fetch dispatched'; })()
steps.name: B1 - dispatch admin force-claim

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.lb2-ft-news-row')].map(r => r.querySelector('.lb2-ft-news-title')?.textContent.trim()); const hasNotify = rows.some(t => (t||'').includes('NOTIFICATIONS')); const cta = !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=mission-enable-notifs]'); return JSON.stringify({ tab:'daily', rows, hasNotifyRow: hasNotify, hasEnableCta: cta, PASS: !hasNotify && !cta, expected:'quest gone from daily featured strip' }); })()
steps.name: C - CORE: quest GONE from daily after claim

steps.expression: (() => { const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('.lb2-ft-news-row')].map(r => r.querySelector('.lb2-ft-news-title')?.textContent.trim()); const hasChallenge = t.some(x => (x||'').includes('CHALLENGE')); return JSON.stringify({ rows:t, wchallengeStillFeatured: hasChallenge, PASS: hasChallenge, expected:'wchallenge must NOT be collateral damage' }); })()
steps.name: D - wchallenge still on daily strip

steps.expression: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.lb2-mission-tab')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'WEEKLY'); if (!b) return 'WEEKLY tab button not found'; b.click(); return 'clicked WEEKLY'; })()
steps.name: E - switch to WEEKLY tab

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.lb2-ft-news-row')]; const row = rows.find(r => (r.querySelector('.lb2-ft-news-title')?.textContent || '').includes('NOTIFICATIONS')); const cta = !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=mission-enable-notifs]'); return JSON.stringify({ rows: rows.map(r => r.querySelector('.lb2-ft-news-title')?.textContent.trim()), notifyRowPresent: !!row, markedDone: !!row && row.className.includes('done'), hasDeadCta: cta, PASS: !!row && row.className.includes('done') && !cta, expected:'present + .done + no leftover CTA (control lives in the bell now)' }); })()
steps.name: F - CORE: still on WEEKLY as a claimed/done row
